summary: Iteration 29 — Phase 2 per-game ad gating (game_ad_config) verification. 9/9 backend tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration29_phase2_gac.py + Expo web UI smoke on all 8 game screens + /admin/game-ads. Backend verified: (1) GET /api/app-config returns game_ad_config containing all 9 keys (checkin, higher_lower, memory, tictactoe, math, daily_challenge, tap, trivia, survey), each with ad_type/chances_per_ad/every_n typed correctly, and defaults match spec (memory + daily_challenge = rewarded; others = interstitial). (2) GET /api/admin/app-config gated by require_admin (401/403 for anonymous device tokens) and exposes game_ad_config. (3) PUT /api/admin/app-config round-trips: changing memory.every_n and higher_lower.every_n persists (re-GET admin AND public both reflect it), and ad_type swap (tap interstitial↔rewarded) also persists via public /app-config; values reset to originals after each test. (4) Regression: single-wallet withdraw still succeeds with NO `source` field (points deducted correctly); /api/campaigns reward_inr respects live exchange ratio for 100/50/200 pts/₹; /api/tasks/surveys/random?limit=1 returns exactly 1 survey with questions. Frontend UI (Expo web @ 390×844): all 8 games open without runtime crash — Higher-Lower shows 'Watch Ad to Get Chances' → RewardedAdModal (countdown + 'Skip ad (no reward)' + auto-claim) → chances 10/10 → Start Round → hl-card renders; Memory Match, Tic-Tac-Toe, Math Sprint (0/10), Tap Rush (0/5), Trivia Streak (0/5) all load with 'Watch Ad to Get Chances' CTA; Daily Challenge box-tap opens RewardED fallback modal ('Watch this ad to claim' + 'Ad ends in Ns...' + 'Skip ad (no reward)') — NOT interstitial, per spec; Daily Check-in 'Check in & earn' opens INTERSTITIAL fallback modal ('Real ads show in the installed app. Tap continue to proceed.' + Continue button) — matches spec. Admin /admin/game-ads renders 9 cards (all keys have data-testid=`gac-<key>`), each with Interstitial/Rewarded toggles + every_n input + chances_per_ad input + hint + Save button; Save PUT persists to /api/admin/app-config (verified memory.every_n=7 round-trip via UI Save then re-GET). Note: /tic-tac-toe, /tap-rush, /trivia-streak are the correct routes (not /tictactoe etc.).

ui_bugs.issue: Chances label is hardcoded '/5' (memory-match.tsx:141 -> `{session.chancesLeft}/5`), but game_ad_config.memory.chances_per_ad defaults to 1 (spec) and is admin-editable. UI now shows 'Chances 0/5' even though one rewarded ad grants only 1 chance. Should read `/{adCfg.chances_per_ad}` or `/{session.maxChances}`.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings on every screen: `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"` and `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Cosmetic on web preview; harmless on native build. Same as iter28 — not a Phase-2 regression.
Warning `[Reanimated] Couldn't load entering/exiting animation. Current version supports only predefined animations with modifiers...` on welcome screen. Same as iter28.

`Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing` on Daily Check-in (Animated.sequence in checkin.tsx). Falls back to JS animation — no functional impact on web preview.

action_items: (LOW) In /app/frontend/app/memory-match.tsx line 141, replace the hard-coded '/5' denominator with `/{adCfg.chances_per_ad}` (or the session's maxChances) so the counter reflects the live admin-configured chances_per_ad. Same review may be worth doing for any other game screen that hardcodes the max chances denominator.
(Non-blocking, from iter28) Replace `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` and move `pointerEvents` from prop to style to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: useGameAdConfig hook (useGameAdConfig.ts) correctly seeds defaults synchronously from the spec map, then hydrates from /api/app-config on mount — no crash if the network is slow. Good.
AppMetaSettings.game_ad_config (server.py:312-322) defaults exactly match useGameAdConfig.ts DEFAULTS — no drift between client and server.
admin/game-ads.tsx merges DEFAULTS with the loaded config (line 60) so new game keys won't break the UI even before PUT.

Daily Challenge (daily-challenge.tsx) uses RewardedAdModal — matches game_ad_config.daily_challenge.ad_type='rewarded'. Note: this file does NOT read useGameAdConfig — it hard-wires the rewarded modal. That's fine for now (spec locks the type for this game), but if admin flips daily_challenge to interstitial in /admin/game-ads, the UI will still show rewarded. Consider gating on adCfg.ad_type in a future pass.

Same one-way pinning applies to checkin.tsx (hard-wired InterstitialAdModal) — admin toggle to 'rewarded' will not be honored. Report to main agent as a spec conformance gap since the review request says 'ad frequency must be admin-editable' and the admin UI exposes ad_type toggles for these games.

success_rate.frontend: smoke-passed on all 8 game screens + admin/game-ads (9 cards render, Save round-trips)

seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_dev_ device users created for withdraw/regression tests; no production data touched. Admin app-config values were mutated during round-trip tests and reset via a `finally` block. During UI test, memory.every_n was set to 7 through the /admin/game-ads Save button; after the test the value was reset back to 0 via API PUT.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration29_phase2_gac.py + test_iteration28_phase1.py for phase 1+2 regression. Admin login on the web preview cannot be triggered by Playwright mouse.down/up long-press — instead, hit /api/auth/device then /api/auth/admin-login and inject the token via `localStorage.setItem('tm_session_token', <tok>)`, then navigate to /admin/*. Correct routes: /tic-tac-toe (hyphens), /tap-rush, /trivia-streak, /math-sprint, /memory-match, /higher-lower, /daily-challenge, /checkin. Fallback ad modal signatures for detection: Rewarded = has 'Watch this ad' + 'Skip ad (no reward)'; Interstitial = has 'Tap continue to proceed' + Continue button.
rca_of_issue: Memory Match denominator bug — memory-match.tsx line 141 hardcodes '/5' because it was originally written for a fixed 5-chances-per-ad game. When Phase 2 wired chances_per_ad through useGameAdConfig(memory)=1, only the numerator (session.chancesLeft) became reactive. Fix: replace with `{session.chancesLeft}/{adCfg.chances_per_ad}` or expose `session.maxChances`.
